title: Examples beyond Bounded Mean Motion for Quantitative Rigidity on the Two-Torus
summary: This note supplies genuinely non-fibred examples for the manuscript: Rigidity on the Two-Torus and Sarnak's Conjecture. For every $0<δ<\tfrac12$, we construct $C^\infty$ Lebesgue-area-preserving pseudo-rotations of $\mathbb{T}^2$ which satisfy the $(C,δ)$-deviation condition but do not have bounded mean motion. We give both semi-irrational and totally irrational rotation vectors and two realizations: a controlled weakly mixing Anosov--Katok construction and an explicit weakly mixing special flow construction.
